Definition:

not(regexmatch(allowed_id_types,"^[teordagms]+$")),"",
not(regexmatch(id,"^["&allowed_id_types&"]\d+$")),"",

 ,TRUE),FALSE,
TRUE,TRUE)

Description: Takes an ID of the form "a1234" and returns 1234 + the number of header rows stored in settings_NumHeaderRows (Named Range cell). Use with INDEX to quickly look up an ID. Only accepts valid ID characters (terodagms).
Takes an ID of the form "a1234" and returns 1234.

Converts an identifier (one character followed by a positive integer serial number up to , e.g. d98) to the corresponding plate number and well position in a series of 96-well plates, numbered by columns (e.g. d98 returns d02.B01). Using an identifier with a serial number >9504 will result in a 3-digit plate ID. Invalid identifiers will be returned without change.
Definition:
=ARRAYFORMULA(
  IF(
    REGEXMATCH(id, "^\D\d+$"),
    IF(
      REGEXMATCH(size, "\d+[w]"),
      IF(
        size = "96w",
        LEFT(id, 1) &
        TEXT(CEILING(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1) / 96), "00") & "." &
        CHAR(
          IF(MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), 8) = 0, 8, MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), 8)) + 64
        ) &
        TEXT(
          CEILING(
            IF(MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), 96) = 0, 96, MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), 96)) / 8
          ),
          "00"
        ),
        IF(
          size = "24w",
          LEFT(id, 1) &
          TEXT(CEILING(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1) / 24), "00") & "." &
          CHAR(
            IF(MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), 4) = 0, 4, MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), 4)) + 64
          ) &
          TEXT(
            CEILING(
              IF(MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), 24) = 0, 24, MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), 24)) / 4
            ),
            "00"
          ),
          id
        )
      ),
      IF(
        REGEXMATCH(size, "\d+[r]\d+[c]"),
        LET(
          plate_rows, REGEXEXTRACT(size, "^(\d+)"),
          plate_columns, REGEXEXTRACT(size, "(?:[r])(\d+)"),
          IF(
            REGEXMATCH(id, "^\D\d+$"),
            LEFT(id, 1) &
            TEXT(
              CEILING(
                RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1) / (plate_rows * plate_columns)
              ),
              "00"
            ) & "." &
            CHAR(
              IF(
                MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), plate_rows) = 0,
                plate_rows,
                MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), plate_rows)
              ) + 64
            ) &
            TEXT(
              CEILING(
                IF(
                  MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), plate_rows * plate_columns) = 0,
                  plate_rows * plate_columns,
                  MOD(RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1), plate_rows * plate_columns)
                ) / plate_rows
              ),
              "00"
            ),
            "#VALUE!"
          )
        ),
        IF(
          REGEXMATCH(size, "[b]\d+"),
          LET(
            box_number, REGEXEXTRACT(size, "(?:[b])(\d+)"),
            id_number, RIGHT(id, LEN(id) - 1),
            "box " & FLOOR((id_number - 1) / box_number) + 1 & ", " & id
          ),
          id
        )
      )
    ),
    id
  )
)

Description: Determines whether the fragments with the given junctions assemble together based on exact matching between the junctions at the fragment ends. If so, the 3' junction of the final assembled fragment is returned. If not, FALSE is returned.

Determines whether the fragments with the given sequences at their ends assemble together based on having a common sequence of length LENGTH. If so, the 3' end sequence of the final assembled fragment is returned. If not, FALSE is returned.
Definition:
=let(
jcts_l,split(jcts_l_pipe_separated_string,"|"),
jcts_r,split(jcts_r_pipe_separated_string,"|"),
ifs(
counta(jcts_l)=1,if(COMMON_SUBSTRING_BY_WINDOW_FROM_LEFT(jcts_l,input_jct_r,length,1),jcts_r,
 if(COMMON_SUBSTRING_BY_WINDOW_FROM_LEFT(DNA_REVERSE_COMPLEMENT(jcts_r),input_jct_r,length,1),DNA_REVERSE_COMPLEMENT(jcts_l),FALSE)),
counta(jcts_l)<>counta(jcts_r),FALSE,
TRUE,let(
match_array_fwd,map(jcts_l,lambda(x,COMMON_SUBSTRING_BY_WINDOW_FROM_LEFT(x,input_jct_r,length,1))),
match_array_rc,map(jcts_r,lambda(x,COMMON_SUBSTRING_BY_WINDOW_FROM_LEFT(DNA_REVERSE_COMPLEMENT(x),input_jct_r,length,1))),
ifs(
 countif({match_array_fwd,match_array_rc},"=TRUE")>1,FALSE,
 countif(match_array_fwd,"=TRUE")=1,
 iferror(
  MATCH_GIBSON_3PRIME(
  join("|",filter(jcts_l,arrayformula(not(match_array_fwd)))),
  join("|",filter(jcts_r,arrayformula(not(match_array_fwd)))),
  index(jcts_r,xmatch(TRUE,match_array_fwd)),
  length),FALSE),
 TRUE,
 iferror(
  MATCH_GIBSON_3PRIME(
  join("|",filter(jcts_l,arrayformula(not(match_array_rc)))),
  join("|",filter(jcts_r,arrayformula(not(match_array_rc)))),
  DNA_REVERSE_COMPLEMENT(index(jcts_l,(xmatch(TRUE,match_array_rc)))),
  length),FALSE)))))
